import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/task/output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Collect all words in column A (rows 1..5000)
words = []
for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    v = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
